name: bank-pack
title: Seasonal cash and bank review
for_each: select id,name from farms order by name

sections.title: Planning basis
sections.note: Internal planning pack, not an application, audited statement or loan recommendation. Cash amounts follow the imported report basis; keep GST treatment consistent.

sections.title: Monthly headroom
sections.sql: select month,basis,net_cents,budget_cents,closing_cents,headroom_cents,cells,status from v_cashflow where farm_id=$1 order by month

sections.title: Budget variance
sections.sql: select enterprise,account,month,budget_cents,actual_cents,variance_cents,coverage from v_variance where farm_id=$1 order by month,account

sections.title: Decisions and deadlines
sections.sql: select kind,record,detail from v_attention where farm_id=$1 order by kind

sections.title: Recorded assumptions
sections.sql: select author,body,created_at from notes where farm_id=$1 order by created_at

name: stock-reconciliation
title: Stock reconciliation working paper
for_each: select id,name from farms order by name

sections.title: Monthly stock movements
sections.note: Arithmetic count check only. No livestock tax valuation, animal traceability filing or physical stock certification.
sections.sql: select enterprise,month,stock_class,opening,births,purchases,sales,deaths,closing,expected_closing,difference from v_livestock where farm_id=$1 order by month

sections.title: Record checks
sections.sql: select record,rule,issue,source from v_compliance where farm_id=$1
